SELECT channel_code, channel_id, staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_lines, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), sum(net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.format, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, count(*) n
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND (s.store_id>=900 OR f.channel_code<>'ST' OR f.channel_code IS NULL)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT o.status, o.fulfilment_type, count(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) orders, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dl
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND (f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2,3))
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dr, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, min(r.return_date), max(r.return_date)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND s.store_id=900
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT (sf.channel_code='WB' OR sf.channel_id IN (2,3)) AS orig_web, s.store_id AS return_store, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dr, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, min(r.return_date), max(r.return_date)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line sf ON sf.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND ((sf.channel_code='WB' OR sf.channel_id IN (2,3)) OR s.store_id=900)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line) rn, (SELECT count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line) rd, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line) sn, (SELECT count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line) sd FROM fact_return_line

WITH web_lines AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, sale_date, net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE channel_code = 'WB' OR channel_id IN (2, 3)
),
sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(w.net_amount) AS sales_before_returns
  FROM web_lines w JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
rets AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) AS returns_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN web_lines w ON w.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period, s.sales_before_returns, coalesce(r.returns_net,0) returns_net, s.sales_before_returns - coalesce(r.returns_net,0) AS net_sales
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period) ORDER BY 2
